mechanics.title: Modifier keys
mechanics.description: Bind actions to key combinations using Alt, Ctrl and Shift. Conflicting bindings still turn red as a warning, but multiple functions can share a key.

mechanics.title: Controls search
mechanics.description: A search bar on the Controls screen filters the long keybind list.

commands_and_keybinds: Keybinds added: Toggle Auto Jump, Toggle Cape, Toggle Hat, Toggle Jacket, Toggle Left/Right Sleeve, Toggle Left/Right Pants Leg, and an alternative Escape key (default keys not confirmed).
getting_started: Open Options > Controls, use the search box, and assign modifier combinations by holding Alt/Ctrl/Shift while binding.
name: Amecs (Fabric)
summary: Improves the Controls screen: keybinds can use Alt, Control and Shift modifiers, several actions can share the same key, and the keybind list has a search bar. It also adds keybinds for toggling auto jump and each skin layer.
